translations.text: Claiming to be wise [?], they became fools.
For when Gentiles who have no law naturally do what the law requires, these people, though they have no law, are a law to themselves.
An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of little children, having in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth.
But now God's righteousness has been revealed apart from the law, with the law and the prophets bearing witness to it.
Does this blessing, then, apply to the circumcised, or also to the uncircumcised? For we say that Abraham's faith was credited to him as righteousness.
For the law produces wrath, but where there is no law, there is no transgression either.
For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, then we will also be united in his resurrection.
For when you were slaves of sin, you were free from righteousness.
I was once alive without the law, but when the commandment came, sin came to life.
So I find concerning the law [?] that evil is present with me, who want to do good.
If we are children, then we are heirs—heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with him so that we may also be glorified with him.
He who did not spare his own Son but gave him up for us all—how will he not also freely give us everything with him?
The patriarchs belong to them, and Christ came from them according to the flesh, he who is God over everyone, blessed forever. Amen.
As he also says in Hosea, 'I will call those who are not my people my people, and her who is not my beloved my beloved.'
Therefore I urge you, my brothers and sisters, through God's mercies, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—your rational worship.
Do not take on the form of this age, but be transformed through the renewal of your mind, so that you may discern what God's will is: what is good, pleasing to him, and perfect.
Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

For when he says, 'You must not commit adultery, you must not murder, you must not steal, you must not covet,' these and all the other commandments are fulfilled in this saying: 'You must love your neighbor as yourself.'
For none of us lives for himself, and none of us will die for himself.
So that I might be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving God's gospel, so that the offering of the Gentiles might be acceptable, made holy by the Holy Spirit.
Therefore I have reason to boast in Christ Jesus before God.
They risked their own necks for my life. Not only I thank them, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
Greet Mary, who worked very hard for you.
Now to him who is able to strengthen you according to my gospel and the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery that was kept silent for ages.
